headline: DCON's 29σ volume surge and GEL's sharp gap-down reversal dominate an otherwise mixed session across IS1 coverage.
market_take: Coverage breadth was firm on activity but split on direction. CONMAT and PF&REIT carried the strongest upside signals, with DCON printing a 29σ spike and PF&REITs M-PAT and AIMCG attracting flow. Food weakened sharply, led by XBIO's -16.67% intraday drop and AQUA's -9.09% slide. PROP was the weakest sector, with KC, PF, A, STELLA, and PRIN all down, though JCK and J bucked the trend on heavy volumes. Several alerts coincided with corporate filings, linking price action to news flow rather than purely technical moves.

sector_notes.note: DCON jumped 7.14% on a 29.0σ volume spike, while GEL opened -20.00% before reversing +25.00% intraday and UMI hit a 10.2σ volume spike, all warranting closer review.

M-PAT gained 13.57% on a +7.14% open gap with a 6.00% intraday move, and AIMCG flagged a 3.5σ volume spike; however, TU-PF flagged non-payment of dividend and TTLPF/ALLY continue to report capital structure changes.
AQUA fell -9.09% and XBIO dropped -16.67% on the day; on the corporate side, OSP reported a CFO change and TKN continued share repurchase filings.
TPOLY opened -11.11% then rallied +25.00% intraday alongside a director resignation filing; PLE opened -14.29% then recovered +16.67%, and SEAFCO printed a 3.1σ volume spike.

Five names declined (KC -33.33%, PF -20.00%, A -13.86%, STELLA -8.33%, PRIN -5.52%), but JCK +9.09% on a 5.3σ volume spike and J +6.10% on a 3.7σ spike stood out; WHA announced a new subsidiary and SC a subsidiary joint venture.
PPPM slipped -5.51% on thin volume; TL filed a SET clarification on its Q2/2026 financial statements that RMs should track.
